license_verification.quote: the various contributors of the imagesets have waived all copyright and related or neighboring rights to BBBC038v1
license_verification.conclusion: Public domain. Nothing downstream inherits a restriction, which is why this was selected over every froth candidate.

adoption_status.what_it_proves: Real photographs with per-object non-overlapping instance masks and densely touching convex objects: the same geometric problem as froth. Adopting it would test whether the ladder generalises beyond the in-repo generator, which is the largest open doubt about the 15-method comparison.
adoption_status.what_it_cannot_prove: Froth accuracy. These are cell nuclei. It must be reported as its own source and never merged into the froth benchmark or described as froth data.

froth_source_search.conclusion: No openly licensed, real, per-bubble-annotated froth dataset exists in public repositories. Every froth candidate is unlicensed (Kaggle), non-commercial (Roboflow, dropped on instruction), or paywalled (IEEE DataPort). Zenodo returns no froth segmentation dataset at all. Froth imagery is operational plant data and plants do not publish it.
froth_source_search.consequence: A genuine froth accuracy claim requires Felipe's own annotated frames. Fifty to a hundred from one cell, with a known camera and a real scale, beats any public alternative because the provenance and the licence are owned.
